messages.label: Pass 1 Trip + Pass 2 Manifest + Math Gate

cards.title: Stage 1–2: Sub-2.5s Edge Gate & Neuro-Symbolic AI
items: Verifies X-Hub-Signature-256, claims WAMID fence token, and locks phone thread
Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite extracts Trip + Guest Manifest with deterministic math overrides
If fields are missing, replies immediately without re-asking known slots (NEVER RE-ASK)

cards.title: Stage 3: AI Tool Calling -> Editable Hono Studio
items: When all 6 core fields are captured (done=true), AI calls submit_quotation_to_hono
Hono computes itemized lines (5 rooms, 4x3d + 4x2d split dives, full-board meals)
Returns editable Studio URL (/quotes/QT-1010-SKY) and shareable link (/q/sky-oct10-group)

cards.title: Stage 4: Staff Confirm -> GAIS Odoo Upsert & Push
items: Staff edits unit prices, rows, or 30% partner discount in /quotes and clicks Confirm
Hono signs payload with X-GAIS-Signature + Idempotency-Key to upsert Odoo sale.order
Confirmed grand total and interactive quotation link are pushed back to guest WhatsApp
